calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 0 AS is_return
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 1
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_return=0 THEN n.net_sales END) AS sold, SUM(CASE WHEN is_return=1 THEN n.net_sales END) AS ret,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2;

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_sold, SUM(r.returns_net) AS ctrl_ret, COUNT(*) AS days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-15'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-15'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-15'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_without_sale', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_not_900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'store900_lines_no_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_on_undispatched_orders', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected');

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, COUNT(*) AS rows_in_dup_groups, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id,f.line_no)) AS groups, MIN(f.sale_date) AS mn, MAX(f.sale_date) AS mx,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT s.store_id AS return_store, (f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) AS orig_is_web, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND (s.store_id=900 OR f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order))
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net_in_stores
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND s.store_id<>900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
